text: Stop looking at other places, this is where you want to come get your treatments! Like many other travelers who use Google reviews to find English friendly places; I did the same. A famous Muay Thai fighter came and left a review which prompted me to visit myself. I showed up unannounced without an appointment on a Tuesday at 11am. The front desk was very professional and courteous while asking questions in order to determine what treatments are necessary. They offer cupping, acupuncture, blood letting, gua sha, ear points and a few others. After speaking with reception, I had lucked out and there was a cancellation. I was able to receive electroacupuncture (once the needles were in place a small current is pulsed through) and cupping. My arm was formally paralyzed from a car wreck and acupuncture is what initially restored it (this was over 10 years ago). I still have some nagging/dormant muscles around my shoulder blade area, this procedure was AMAZING, the doctor was able to pinpoint the precise problem areas. Now for those of you on the fence about needles, there isn’t any pain, you don’t feel the needle going in, now you will feel it when it reaches your problem area but any pain associated with it will be fixed (think of it like the gym, it has to hurt before it can get better). Acupuncture is REAL, it WORKS, trust the process. Don’t hesitate to come here, amazing personnel and bedside manner. Oh and if you will be here for a while they offer multiple session packages. They are available on both Line/Whatsapp as well. Again, you want to come here if you are in Pattaya and seeking traditional Chinese treatment methods. I will most definitely be returning in the future!!!
